question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Judgment"** means the ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions. (निर्णय)

 
 
• **Example:** His** judgment** was highly respected by his peers.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word should be **"Judgement"** in British English. (निर्णय)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge's **judgement** was fair and just.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Relevant** (प्रासंगिक): Closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.

 
 
• **Example:** The lawyer presented all the **relevant** evidence to the court.
 
 
 
• **Chief** (प्रमुख): Most important or main.
 
 
• **Example:** The **chief **reason for the company's success is its innovative approach.
 
 
 
• **Colleague** (सहकर्मी): A person with whom one works in a profession or business.
 
 
• **Example:** She is well-liked by her **colleagues** for her supportive nature.
